schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE INSURANCE (
    PID INT,
    TIV_2015 NUMERIC,
    TIV_2016 NUMERIC,
    LAT NUMERIC,
    LON NUMERIC,
    PRIMARY KEY (PID),
    CHECK (TIV_2015 >= 0),
    CHECK (TIV_2016 >= 0)
);
q1: SELECT ROUND(SUM(TIV_2016),2) TIV_2016 FROM INSURANCE WHERE TIV_2015 IN (SELECT TIV_2015 FROM INSURANCE GROUP BY TIV_2015 HAVING COUNT(*)>1) AND (LAT,LON) IN (SELECT LAT,LON FROM INSURANCE GROUP BY LAT,LON HAVING COUNT(*)=1)
q2: SELECT SUM(BASE.TIV_2016) AS TIV_2016 FROM ( SELECT A.PID, A.TIV_2016 FROM (SELECT * FROM INSURANCE WHERE TIV_2015 IN (SELECT TIV_2015 FROM (SELECT TIV_2015, COUNT(*) AS N FROM INSURANCE GROUP BY TIV_2015)BASE15 WHERE N>1) ) A LEFT JOIN INSURANCE B ON A.PID !=B.PID AND A.LAT=B.LAT AND A.LON=B.LON WHERE B.PID IS NULL )BASE
